views.name: business_booking_schedule
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    business_id,
    environment,
    quote_id,
    document,
    address,
    starts_at,
    time_zone,
    duration_minutes,
    status,
    version,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    customer_id,
    assignment_version,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'active', s.active) ORDER BY (lower(s.name)), s.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (business_booking_staff a
             JOIN business_staff s ON ((s.id = a.staff_id)))
          WHERE (a.booking_id = b.id)), '[]'::jsonb) AS assigned_staff,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(a.staff_id) AS array_agg
           FROM business_booking_staff a
          WHERE (a.booking_id = b.id)), '{}'::uuid[]) AS staff_ids,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('booking_id', o.id, 'staff_id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'starts_at', o.starts_at, 'duration_minutes', o.duration_minutes)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (((business_booking_staff a
             JOIN business_booking_staff a2 ON ((a2.staff_id = a.staff_id)))
             JOIN business_bookings o ON ((o.id = a2.booking_id)))
             JOIN business_staff s ON ((s.id = a.staff_id)))
          WHERE ((a.booking_id = b.id) AND (o.id <> b.id) AND (o.business_id = b.business_id) AND (o.environment = b.environment) AND (b.status = ANY (ARRAY['Scheduled'::text, 'In Progress'::text])) AND (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['Scheduled'::text, 'In Progress'::text])) AND (b.starts_at < (o.starts_at + ((o.duration_minutes)::double precision * '00:01:00'::interval))) AND (o.starts_at < (b.starts_at + ((b.duration_minutes)::double precision * '00:01:00'::interval))))), '[]'::jsonb) AS conflicts
   FROM business_bookings b;

views.name: business_invoice_list
views.definition:
SELECT i.id,
    i.business_id,
    i.environment,
    i.booking_id,
    i.document,
    i.due_on,
    i.state,
    i.version,
    i.number,
    i.share_token,
    i.sender,
    i.created_at,
    i.issued_at,
    i.voided_at,
    i.void_reason,
    invoice_private.total(i.document) AS total,
    COALESCE(p.paid, (0)::numeric) AS paid,
    ((invoice_private.total(i.document))::numeric - COALESCE(p.paid, (0)::numeric)) AS balance,
        CASE
            WHEN (i.state = 'Draft'::text) THEN 'Draft'::text
            WHEN (i.state = 'Void'::text) THEN 'Void'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(p.paid, (0)::numeric) = (invoice_private.total(i.document))::numeric) THEN 'Paid'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(p.paid, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'Part Paid'::text
            ELSE 'Unpaid'::text
        END AS status,
    i.replaces_id
   FROM (business_invoices i
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (business_invoice_payments.reversal_of IS NULL) THEN business_invoice_payments.amount
                    ELSE (- business_invoice_payments.amount)
                END) AS paid
           FROM business_invoice_payments
          WHERE (business_invoice_payments.invoice_id = i.id)) p ON (true));

views.name: business_quote_list
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    business_id,
    environment,
    enquiry_id,
    document,
    expires_on,
    status,
    version,
    share_token,
    sender,
    created_at,
    sent_at,
    responded_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ((status = 'Sent'::text) AND (expires_on < ((now() AT TIME ZONE (sender ->> 'time_zone'::text)))::date)) THEN 'Expired'::text
            ELSE status
        END AS effective_status
   FROM business_quotes q;
